name: Cohere Transcribe 03-2026
purpose: Dedicated open-source audio-in, text-out ASR model trained from scratch (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card: "This model is governed by an Apache 2.0 license." Repo files are gated (accept conditions on HF), so the file text could not be opened; the Apache-2.0 text is canonical (canonical Apache-2.0 text read in https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-ASR/blob/main/LICENSE).

architecture.kind: AUTOREGRESSIVE Conformer encoder + lightweight Transformer decoder (small decoder)

benchmarks.name: German WER, Open ASR multilingual track (7 of 8 datasets)
benchmarks.harness: Open ASR Leaderboard multilingual track, German column (WER %), read from the Space config JSON 2026-11-19; rows differ in how many of the 8 datasets they cover

benchmarks.name: Open ASR English avg WER (leaderboard rank 22 of 69)
benchmarks.harness: Open ASR Leaderboard English track, read 2026-11-19

benchmarks.name: RTFx on the leaderboard (English track, leaderboard GPU)

strengths: Long-form chunking built in (55 min example)
weaknesses: No timestamps, no diarization, no language detection
soft.maturity: Cohere; gated repository; broad ecosystem support.

tona_fit.reason: Under the updated rule: Apache-2.0, 2B, fits every class, and the independent Open ASR German column puts it at 3.10 (7 of 8 sets), ahead of Parakeet v3 (4.12) and Whisper large-v3 (4.00); no timestamps limits recording use. Tona has no audio module (blocker, not a quality verdict).

sources.note: Open ASR Leaderboard paper; summarised by the fetch tool

open_questions: why_this_design: builder states none beyond "trained from scratch"
